title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Duo #11 (CzechBohemian+KoreanNajeon+KlimtMosaic+VasarelyOpArt / FinnishIittala+ChineseCizhou+GeorgianMinonkari+CubistFragment)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, bold and confident, soft rose-gold hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework, wide silver bands, dense engraved floral facets) dominates one zone. Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands, dense dense scrollwork) dominates the second zone. Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, wide gold bands, dense organic curved mosaic) dominates the third zone. Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands, dense optical illusion grid) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Left woman's footwear: extreme ankle-strap stilettos, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, bold and confident, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs, wide cream bands, dense concentric ripple linework) dominates one zone. Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands, dense leaf scrolls) dominates the second zone. Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands, dense cloisonné floral wirework) dominates the third zone. Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands, dense angular fragment planes) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform high-heel mules, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
